description: This script checks authentication and status for Claude Code and OpenClaw, including token expiration, profile information, and service status. It also supports outputting the status in JSON, simple, or detailed formats.

methods.name: fetch_models_status_json
methods.description: Fetches models status in JSON format from the openclaw CLI.

methods.name: calc_status_from_expires
methods.description: Calculates status based on expiration timestamp, indicating whether token is missing, expired, expiring soon, or valid.

methods.name: json_expires_for_claude_cli
methods.description: Extracts the expiration timestamp for Claude from the JSON status.

methods.name: json_expires_for_anthropic_any
methods.description: Extracts the maximum expiration timestamp for any anthropic profile in the JSON status.

methods.name: json_best_anthropic_profile
methods.description: Determines the profile ID with the latest expiration for anthropic profiles.

methods.name: json_anthropic_api_key_count
methods.description: Counts the number of API keys for the 'anthropic' provider in the JSON status.

methods.name: check_claude_code_auth
methods.description: Checks the current authentication status of Claude Code, considering JSON mode and credential file existence.

methods.name: check_openclaw_auth
methods.description: Checks the current authentication status of OpenClaw, considering JSON mode and profile existence.
